Description: Faders, mutes and meters of Behringer X-Air mixers on your Stream Deck.
Name: X-Air Controller

Localization.A mixer channel on a dial: level, mute a: A mixer channel on a dial: level, mute and its meter.

key.setup_hint: Enter its address in the settings
key.choose_hint: In the settings of this dial

pi.mixer_address_hint: The IP address of your X-Air mixer, or search for it below.
pi.no_mixer_found: No mixer answered. Is it on the same network? Over a VPN, enter its address instead.
pi.fader_help: Rotate: level · Push: mute · Tap: 0 dB (hold: -∞)
pi.meter_style_hint: Digital and Classic show the channel's meter; Ring and Pie show only the fader.
pi.channel_help: Press: mute · Hold: reset peak and clip
pi.thin_meter_hint: A small level bar along the bottom of the key
pi.send_help: Rotate: send level · Push: send off/on · Tap: 0 dB (hold: -∞)
pi.send_style_hint: The meter is the channel's; the marker is the send level.
pi.mute_group_title_hint: Shown instead of "MG n" (the mixer has no names for mute groups)
pi.snapshot_help: Loads a snapshot: the whole mix changes
pi.snapshot_mode_hint: Press twice: the first press arms the key (it pulses yellow for 2 s), the second loads.
